behavior.name: 0x13004ab0
behavior.comment: Movement is defined by a path index and type, both stored in the behavior parameters. It can spawn trajectory marker balls to indicate its path.
behavior.description: A platform that moves along a predefined set of waypoints. It can behave as a ski lift, a carpet, or a standard platform, with some types featuring specialized rocking or sinking effects.

field.name: Path and Type
field.description: Combines a path index (mask 0x0F) and a platform type (mask 0x10).

field.name: Spawn Marker Balls
field.description: Whether the platform spawns trajectory marker balls as it moves.
